title: The Save-and-Share Button
goal: When work is good, we PUSH it to the cloud — like mailing a drawing.
mascot_lines: When you make something cool, we save it.
Then we PUSH it to the cloud.
Now it lives safely AND your grandma can see it!

payload.prompt: Type the word builders use to share work:

tier2.rephrase: Builders share their work with a special word. It rhymes with bush.
